create_mcp_toolset: create an MCP toolset record in the database with tools, metadata, and creator info
get_mcp_toolset: retrieve a single MCP toolset record by its unique toolset ID
list_mcp_toolsets: list MCP toolset records filtered by a set of toolset IDs
get_mcp_toolset_by_name: find a single MCP toolset record by its name
update_mcp_toolset: update an existing MCP toolset record with new fields and tracker info
